comparative_performance.comparison_metric: At the [100], [010], [001] and [110] directions, Fe0.125Mn0.875Al shows the maximum Young's modulus among the Fe1-xMnxAl series, while MnAl shows the minimum.

processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: Geometry-optimized crystal structure via first-principles DFT using CASTEP; GGA-PBE exchange-correlation, ultrasoft pseudopotentials, 8x8x8 Monkhorst-Pack k-point mesh, 450 eV plane-wave cutoff, total energy converged to 2x10^-6 eV and forces below 0.5 eV/nm.

electrical_properties.conductivity: metallic (nonzero density of states at the Fermi level)

measurement_conditions.environment: first-principles DFT (ground-state) calculation; elastic moduli from Voigt-Reuss-Hill approximation

structures.overall_structure: Cubic supercell (space group Pm-3m) with Mn substituting Fe on the Fe sublattice of B2-type FeAl; 16-atom cell with 7 Mn and 1 Fe on the Fe/Mn sublattice and 8 Al on the other sublattice.

unmapped_findings: Lattice parameter (DFT-optimized): a = b = c = 0.582 nm for Fe0.125Mn0.875Al (Table 1, [b0021]).
Elastic constants: C11 = 255.2 GPa, C12 = 138.8 GPa, C44 = 154.2 GPa (Table 2, [b0049]).
Bulk modulus B = 171.5 GPa; shear modulus G = 85.6 GPa; Poisson's ratio σ = 0.286; B/G = 2.00 (Table 2, [b0049]).
Pugh ductility: B/G = 2.00 > 1.75, so Fe0.125Mn0.875Al is classified as ductile ([b0045]).
Anisotropy indices: A^U = 1.84, A_B = 0, A_G = 0.115, A_1 = A_2 = A_3 = 2.65 (Table 3, [b0051]).
Anisotropy ordering (descending): MnAl > Fe0.5Mn0.5Al > Fe0.625Mn0.375Al > Fe0.125Mn0.875Al > Fe0.375Mn0.625Al > Fe0.75Mn0.25Al > Fe0.25Mn0.75Al > Fe0.875Mn0.125Al > FeAl ([b0059]).
